description:
Read-only reachability probe run from THIS machine, OUTSIDE the box: tests whether
    the server's ports are actually reachable over the internet - proving the VPS provider's
    firewall (your provider's security group / cloud firewall) allows them. Run after
    config_apply: if 80 is closed, Cloudflare and browsers can't reach Odoo even
    though it's running fine on the box. Checks 80 + 443 by default.
name: preflight_ports
